correctness.rationale: Universal two-sided modal commutation is equivalent to suffix-image equality for all valuations and hence to the top-fixed binary-increment normal form. Image restriction is surjective and gives tau(f)=1+tau(g); counting the free prefix zeros yields the exact binomial recurrence. The proof constructs all times and counts the exact maximal-time fibers. Exhaustive finite semantic and power checks of the actual standalone checker passed (VERIFY_OK 8158).

value.rationale: A naturally constrained dynamic-topological system asks when all nested-next observations become stationary. The exact defect-conditioned finite stabilization census, full support and exact worst-time fiber sizes determine a relevant precise invariant absent from the inspected rank-count and asymptotic results. The recurrence works at every chain size and has a direct, reproducible finite interpretation; no downstream theorem is required to justify this motivated complete classification.
